scenes.say: SmallTalk. It hears what the other person loves, and tells you what to say next.
Wear it on display glasses or a headset, or put your phone on the table. It only listens once you confirm the other person knows.
scenes.caption: Glasses, headset or phone

scenes.say: Here is a sample first coffee. As they mention Sally Rooney, Phoebe Bridgers and Past Lives, each one is found in Qloo.
scenes.caption: Everything they mention, found in Qloo

scenes.say: Qloo turns those into their taste: what people like them also love, and, from your own favourites, what you share. Lucy Dacus, Sufjan Stevens, boygenius.
scenes.caption: Their taste, and what you share

scenes.say: When they say they cannot stand superhero films, that goes on the list of things to steer clear of.
scenes.caption: And what to avoid

scenes.say: Then it suggests what to say next, built only on what Qloo returned. Have you heard Lucy Dacus's new album?
scenes.caption: What to say next, from Qloo

scenes.say: Ask a language model alone, with the same conversation, and only one of its six suggestions fits their taste.
scenes.caption: Without Qloo, 1 of 6 fit

scenes.say: On display glasses it shows one nudge, large, white on black.
scenes.caption: One glance

scenes.say: SmallTalk. Know what to say next.
